text:
Silver Price in 2009
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2009, the LBMA silver price rose 35.8% between 2009-01-30 ($12.51) and 2009-12-31 ($16.99). The highest sampled price was $18.14 in November and the lowest was $12.51 in January. The mean of these observations was $14.77. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
